name: @mythicalos/telemetry
description: The shared mythicalOS heartbeat client: the frozen envelope and per-product bodies, the canonical runtime validator, derived instance identity, consent state with provenance, and an SSRF-isolated dual-send transport. Pseudonymous by design and honest about it. Apache-2.0.

scripts.build: echo '@mythicalos/telemetry publishes TypeScript source — there is no build step, and no dist/ to drift from src/.'
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check:manifest && bun test && bun run typecheck
